issues.where: the base, frames 668 to 676 (11.13 to 11.27 s)
issues.what: the base morphs in full view. At 668 the carved dark wood has already turned red-brown under the icicles. At 672 it becomes an off-model glowing orange drum with a snow lip and drips, matching neither winter nor spring. At 676 it is moss and roots. That is three different bases in about 8 frames of a shake, so the eye catches the orange flash at normal speed
issues.fix: swap the base on one frame with no in-between state, hidden at the fastest stroke under full motion blur or behind the densest part of the storm. Keep its silhouette and its lighting matched across the cut

issues.where: the base, frames 1392 to 1400 (23.20 to 23.33 s)
issues.what: the base melts on screen. At 1392 the moss is half washed out to yellow and cream, so the base is half spring and half summer. At 1396 it is a soft cream sack with a glowing see-through skirt and sand spilling out under it. At 1400 it firms into the shell base. The base change happens where the eye can catch it
issues.fix: same as the winter change: hard-swap the base on one hidden frame with no blend, and keep the lower edge and the contact shadow solid across the swap

issues.where: the table surface around the base, frames 672 to 680
issues.what: the large frost snowflake under the globe is there at 672 and gone at 676. Pink petals cover the whole surface at once at 676 and are thicker still at 680. The surface dressing pops and is wiped on instead of answering the change or falling in
issues.fix: let the frost melt or fade over several hundred ms after the landing, and let the petals drift down and land a few at a time through the arrival

issues.what: the petal litter disappears in one step between 1392 and 1396, and sand patches appear at the same moment. The surface pops in step with the base swap
issues.fix: clear the petals gradually (blow away, fade, or let them stay until the arrival) and grow the sand in over the arrival, not on the swap frame

issues.where: inside the glass, frames 672 and 676; also set-C-01.jpg frames 1392 and 1396
issues.what: the inside of the globe turns into a flat milky white-pink disc with no flakes and no swirl. The storm stops reading as particles in liquid just when it should be densest, so the swap reads as a crossfade to white
issues.fix: hide the swap behind a dense storm of distinct, moving, motion-blurred flakes or petals at many depths, not a uniform haze

issues.where: the floor and the base glow, frame 672
issues.what: a strong warm light spills from the base onto the surface for that one frame and is gone by 676, so the lighting pops. A similar bright white wash shows on the floor to the left at set-C-01.jpg 1392
issues.fix: keep the key light and the base's light on the surface constant through the swap, and bring any change of season warmth in slowly over the arrival

issues.where: the whole frame, 864 to 886, continuing into set-B-08.jpg
issues.what: the camera starts a slow push-in while the arrival is still growing in. It is eased, but at the end of sheet 8 it is still speeding up, so it is unclear whether it lands with weight
issues.fix: confirm the push has an eased start and an eased settle, and keep it clear of the swap window

issues.where: the floor just in front of the base, frames 1384 and 1388
issues.what: a small grey-white smudge appears on the surface for a couple of frames and does not belong to any object
issues.fix: remove the stray patch, or tie it to a real petal or a real reflection
